performance-review.json.checklist: performance-source-scan.json; exact matching-line and occurrence counts are retained before classification.

findings.title: Complete accepted-launch payload is decoded and all original assignments validated for each source observation
findings.impact: Reads, allocations and validation scale with the whole accepted plan, although the caller needs one original assignment. No speedup or capacity claim is made before measurement.
findings.fix: Measure width and payload-size scaling using existing pure prepared-launch fixtures; if material, design an immutable accepted source/step projection in Processes.Persistence with explicit versioned migration/compatibility and unchanged current authorization, rather than a global cache.

findings.title: Hashing the accepted payload copies the full selected-policy payload through string concatenation and UTF8 bytes
findings.impact: The selected-policy domain prefix plus retained payload creates a complete extra string and the shared hash helper allocates a UTF8 byte array before hashing. This compounds full graph decoding.
findings.fix: Measure allocation contribution; consider bounded incremental UTF8 hashing with exact legacy digest and surrogate-boundary compatibility tests only if justified.

findings.title: Reflection serializer call sites
findings.impact: Five invocations on four lines use cached/default metadata; three are write/initial-commit comparison sites and two are on source reads. Source generation alone does not avoid whole-payload work.
findings.fix: Keep current options and converters; measure before any source-generation change and preserve byte-compatible source identities.

ruledOut: Two ContainsKey calls on one line query different keys and do not pair with indexer reads.
Seven LINQ operator occurrences on six lines include EF translated queries and initialization/legacy reservation; no blanket LINQ rewrite.
No regex, substring, culture-case conversion, Task.Run wrapper, async void, blocking task, stackalloc loop, per-call HttpClient or explicit mutable static dictionary in the two-file scope.
performance-review.json.consistency: Sibling authority/prepared-launch scan found the existing cached Options field, but no local JsonSerializerContext, IncrementalHash, Utf8JsonWriter or ToHexStringLower variant to reuse. No claim of repository-wide absence.
performance-review.json.qualification: Static source review narrows the measurements; it does not establish throughput or a speedup. The algorithmic whole-plan scaling assessment is a separate manual design finding, beyond API-pattern matching.

architecture-review.json.review: Registered Process initial and schema7 live sources use exact canonical parent/content, original accepted full policy and current generation fences. One cohesive shared binding decoder replaces historical duplication. Query result carries immutable original policy already read; persisted dispatch snapshot and fingerprints stay unchanged. Generic decision-policy dispatch and inherited ordinary reservation remain refused. No project references, runtime partials, new interfaces or global cache. Product producer/manager and atomic outcomes remain gated. One new informational COMPLEXITY-002 finding reports9 members on the110-line ProcessToolBackgroundSourcePolicy. Reviewed: these are its existing reservation/live entry, explicit inherited entry, one shared observer/query and current-profile check, all owning Process source authorization. The pure canonical binding decoder is shared with history; splitting this small policy would add indirection without a separate owner. Two existing findings only moved source lines. No scoped cycle.
